title: TRUCK HOT POTATO
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create original transparent PNG box-title artwork for the arcade semi-truck sport TRUCK HOT POTATO. The supplied Red Light Green Light artwork is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: keep its rowdy, worn 1999–2003 PlayStation 2 box-logo feel, NOT its arrangement or palette. Invent a distinct compact asymmetric composition. Exact readable words: TRUCK HOT POTATO. HOT POTATO is dominant, TRUCK smaller but expressive. Chunky irregular hand-painted letters, orange-red scraped enamel faces, deep aubergine ink extrusion, thick soot-black contours and aged cream keyline. Strong angular painted highlights, chipped edges, worn screen-print scratches; confident simple silhouette readable at small menu size. A gigantic cartoon ticking round bomb integrated as the O in HOT, a short rope fuse with one bold star-shaped spark; a subtle bumper/skid element integrated into the baseline. Tension and ridiculous passing motion conveyed by the lettering itself. No realistic explosives construction detail. No extra words, no stock font, no glossy mobile-game finish, no polished chrome, no busy mascot illustration, no rectangle, no badge, no poster backdrop. Genuinely transparent outside the artwork and within letter counters. Leave 8% transparent padding around every side, no clipped letters or outline. One finished original sport logo.
